title: Quality Studio security hardening
summary: Decision-ready hardening plan for untrusted repository ingestion, review-agent and sensor isolation, credential handling, dependency advisories, result rendering, and downstream handover.

implementationState.note: S0 is not yet operator-approved (status remains decision-pending); the following S0 items were implemented as an emergency brake because they were already independently justified by a confirmed live vulnerability (repo-scoped PUT client could set a sensor 'command' and trigger host command execution), not as approval of the full S0-S6 plan.

delivered: Registrar privilege required for repository sensor/root/archive mutations (PUT/DELETE /api/repos/{repoId} now 403 without CanRegisterRepositories)
Command-backed analyzer sensors (sarif/roslyn/eslint/tsc) disabled by default via QualityStudio:Security:AllowCommandBackedAnalyzers, enforced at registration and at the sensor
Spend rate limiter applied to sensor scan endpoints
notDelivered: Host-owned immutable analyzer profile IDs (target design beyond the emergency brake)
Origin + anti-CSRF nonce for local mutations; fail-startup on non-loopback Local bind
